note: Heart lifestyle options. Exercise and quitting smoking numbers come from large cohort studies (people followed over time, not randomized), so they show links, not proof. Weight loss is from a randomized trial plus a meta-analysis of trials.

quit_smoking.source: Jha et al., 21st-Century Hazards of Smoking and Benefits of Cessation in the United States, NEJM 2013;368:341-350 (US National Health Interview Survey, about 200,000 adults)
quit_smoking.how: Heart attack and stroke risk with and without smoking: the PREVENT equations, run on your answers. Death from heart disease or stroke: our NHANES model, run with and without smoking.
quit_smoking.verified_against: Campaign for Tobacco-Free Kids summary and LA Times report of the paper

exercise.recommendation: 150 to 300 minutes a week of vigorous exercise (running, fast cycling, swimming laps), or 300 to 600 minutes of moderate exercise (brisk walking, easy cycling), plus muscle strengthening (weights, bands, push-ups) for 30 to 60 minutes a week over 2 or more days.
exercise.source: Lee DH et al., Long-Term Leisure-Time Physical Activity Intensity and All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality, Circulation 2022;146:523-534 (116,221 adults, 30 years)

cv_death.label: death from heart disease or stroke, vigorous exercise 75-149 min/week (the guideline amount) vs none

any_death.label: death from any cause, same comparison

life_years.label: at 450+ minutes a week of brisk walking or the same amount of exercise, vs none, after age 40
life_years.source: Moore et al., PLoS Medicine 2012;9:e1001335 (654,827 adults)

low_dose.label: at up to 75 minutes a week of brisk walking

strength.source: Momma et al., British Journal of Sports Medicine 2022;56:755-763 (16 studies)
strength.strength_alone: 10 to 20% lower risk of death and of heart disease at 30 to 60 minutes a week

exercise.verified_against: Lee 2022 abstract and table 2; Moore 2012 abstract; Momma 2022 BMJ press release

weight_loss.source: Neter et al., Influence of Weight Reduction on Blood Pressure, Hypertension 2003;42:878-884 (25 randomized trials, 4,874 people)

trial.source: Look AHEAD Research Group, Cardiovascular Effects of Intensive Lifestyle Intervention in Type 2 Diabetes, NEJM 2013;369:145-154 (5,145 adults with type 2 diabetes and overweight, median 9.6 years)

weight_loss.verified_against: Neter 2003 abstract; ACC trial summary of Look AHEAD
